name: Top Corner
design_intent:
S3 SOCCER TRIALS #2 -- the LOFT shot. The goal mouth is mounted HIGH on the right wall (zone y360-680; bottom edge sits 420px above the deck, center 580px up -- inside the 500-700 elevation brief), so a flat drive can never score: the player must dive UNDER the ball and strike its underside so the away/travel blend in Ball._drive_from points up-right (~45 deg). Teaches angle control on the shoulder-drive that s3_tap_in introduced flat.

DERIVED SHOT (Ball.gd: dv = (500 + 0.9*speed)/0.6, x2 super; gravity 1600): ball rests at (900,1040) on the deck (top 1100). A full boost-speed (760) underside hit gives 1973 px/s; at 45 deg that is vx = vy = 1395. Apex rise = 1395^2/(2*1600) = 608px > the 520px needed to reach goal center. The ball enters the zone's left edge (x1600) at t=0.50s at y=542 -- inside the y360-680 band -- SCORE. Angle window at full drive is roughly 40-55 deg: at 30 deg apex rise is only 304px so the ball smacks the wall below the mouth (contact y~739) and bounces back; at 60 deg it crosses x1600 at y~230, sails OVER the wall top (y300) and out of bounds -- auto-reset, try again. A lazy half-speed touch also fails honestly: approach 400 px/s => drive 1433, 45-deg apex 321px, peaking at y~719 just short and below the band. So the shot REQUIRES a committed full-boost approach plus a read of the strike angle -- the jetpack is the club. A super-drive (ball capped at 2400; 45 deg apex 900px) overshoots the mouth high and caroms off the wall top region; normal boost is the intended tool.

NO-AUTO-SCORE GUARD: pure elevation. The zone's bottom edge (y680) is 420px above the resting ball's center path (y1040 rolling on the deck); the deck runs flush into the wall base so a rolling ball just stops against the wall far below the mouth. Zero gravity-only path from spawn rest into the zone.

PLAYER: spawns at (450,1000) on the open left deck, 450px from the ball, no hazards -- safe. Deck is marshmallow (bounces), wall is bumper, void below kills. Misses reset via settle (2.8s) or OOB; the ~15-deg angle window at a natural full-boost speed makes this an average-player clear well inside 90s of tries.
hint: HIT IT LOW - LOFT IT TO THE TOP CORNER
